name: Kachou Suimei
source: A mechanical engineering researcher who graduated college at the age of 14. Works under the parents of Kiriku. Very talented and excels at many things. He is on good terms with Kiriku's parents and often visits them, but he has never had a proper conversation with Kiriku.
